summary.zh: 偏斜与威慑叠出 20 级无人能及的招架，诱捕则让每个陷阱都附带定身。
summary.en: Deflection and Deterrence stack parry beyond anything else available at 20, with Entrapment turning every trap into a root.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，以扛住近战和单挑为目标，而非追求伤害
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, surviving melee and duels rather than maximising damage

pros.zh: 偏斜点满提供 5% 招架，是这个阶段单项收益最大的防御天赋。
pros.en: Deflection adds 5% parry at five points, the largest single defensive gain this early.

pros.zh: 威慑可主动开启，10 秒内躲闪与招架各提高 25%。
pros.en: Deterrence adds 25% dodge and parry for 10 seconds on demand.

pros.zh: 诱捕让陷阱命中的目标定身 3 秒，野蛮打击再为近战技能提供 4% 暴击。
pros.en: Entrapment roots everything your traps catch for 3 seconds, and Savage Strikes adds 4% critical strike to your melee abilities.

pros.zh: 练级速度与纯输出请看野兽控制或射击；20 级的生存是一套生存能力向的选择，来源指南本身也是这么说的。
pros.en: Levelling speed and raw damage come from Beast Mastery or Marksmanship; Survival at 20 is a durability pick, and the guide that publishes it says so.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
